DB.description: Stores mailboxes, permissions and event histories. D1 migrations run before Worker deployment.

MAIL_BLOBS.description: Private mail and attachment storage. Enable R2 in the selected account first.

MAIL_DOMAIN.description: Your dedicated agent mail domain, for example agent.yourdomain.tld.

OWNER_EMAIL.description: Your Owner email, matching the Cloudflare Access identity.

CONSOLE_ORIGIN.description: Console HTTPS origin. Example defaults are replaced with this account workers.dev URL during deployment.

API_ORIGIN.description: API HTTPS origin. Example defaults use the same workers.dev URL.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Optional at first deploy. Configure Access through /setup; Owner endpoints remain protected until configured.

ACCESS_AUD.description: Access application audience. Configure through /setup after deployment.

WEBHOOK_KEYRING.description: Optional Worker secret for Webhook signing key encryption. Leave empty until Webhooks are enabled; never enter a Cloudflare management token.
